entry.label: Practice: Interactive planning: design the service you would choose now
entry.description: Distinguish an idealised design from a forecast, then work back to feasible changes and learning. A small rehearsal of Ackoff's interactive planning and idealised design. It is not an invitation to ignore present feasibility, affected people or implementation.
